source_scope: Eleven explicitly project-defined/non-vendor entries use the project's own public specification. Six are optional local management metadata/input-policy extensions, not newly observed manufacturer fields. Their classification does not erase historical research or establish a manufacturer schema.

decisions.description: A locally selected fail-closed refusal code for invalid/unavailable control operations. The project does not claim that this number is the manufacturer's required error code, or that all controller versions interpret it identically.
A locally selected unsupported-operation refusal code in the project's JSON control replies. It is not an HTTP response status here and is not claimed to have a manufacturer-defined meaning.

The retained status profile string ubntbox-0.1.7-v1-info is a legacy project diagnostic identifier. Retaining its spelling avoids silently changing existing status consumers; it does not claim vendor implementation parity, vendor origin or independent observation of a binary.
An explicitly synthetic lab task path. The fixture suffix is invented by this project and is not a real controller task ID or an assertion of native endpoint acceptance.
An explicitly synthetic lab image path. The fixture suffix is invented; this lab example neither carries camera media nor demonstrates native image-route acceptance.

A locally permitted optional management-metadata label for content-free diagnostic field counting and bounded string pass-through. It is not required to establish controller identity, TLS trust, adoption confirmation or credentials, and is not emitted as a required manufacturer control field. No claim is made that Protect sends or requires this optional alias.

A local optional zero-mode policy in this project's adoption API and state: an omitted mode is treated as zero; only numeric zero or string zero is accepted. The outbound x-mode header has its own separate source record and is not derived from an arbitrary supplied mode. This is a conservative local input restriction, not a claim that a manufacturer management payload must contain mode.
